guides.favoredWhen: Deny his level-2 all-in through minions, and never get hooked under your own tower.

keyTips.text: Stand behind your minions at level 1 and poke him and his carry down: entering level 2 behind on health removes the all-in he queued for.
Never stand in his hook range while his wave crashes into your tower: getting hooked under your own tower is the one death pattern you cannot heal through.
Track his ult ({cd:111:R}) and give ground while it is up: his engage without it is only a hook, so bait it out, then zone him for its full duration.

tips.text: Take the side bush first for early poke, then play behind your wave: if he does land a hook, steady healing out-sustains it as long as the wave is not crashing into you.
Start extra health into his engage and build toward Knight's Vow first: the early health plus redirection blunts his all-in better than rushing your enchanter core.
Save silence for the follow-up diver instead of spending it on him: his hook is the entry but the carry dash is the kill, so hold E for that.
Ping his roams the moment he leaves and hover within reach of mid: he cannot do much alone, so answering his move denies the pick.
Set up objectives behind walls and let him come to you: with terrain breaking his hook lanes, he has to walk into your silence and focus to start a fight.

Once Knight's Vow is done and Moonstone is coming online, bait his engage onto yourself and heal through it: with his cooldowns spent and your redirection plus healing up, your team wins the extended fight.

guides.favoredWhen: Poke him out at level 1 and match his resets; hold silence for the diver and never walk up without minions.

keyTips.text: Open level 1 behind your minions and trade autos plus Q whenever their carry steps for farm: entering level 2 ahead on health takes away the all-in they queued for.
Dodge hooks by walking straight back out of range instead of sidestepping: lateral movement keeps you inside the hook's path longer, while a straight retreat exits it.
Hold silence for the diver onto your carry, then answer with Q and heals: spending E early leaves nothing for the engage that actually kills.

tips.text: Click his portrait at level 1 to see whether he started Q or E from the buff icon: when his E is missed or absent, run the lane down while he has no trade-back.
Do not blow summoners over a level-1 hook: without ranks and backup damage it cannot kill you, so save your spells for the level-2 window that matters.
Base when he bases so you share his roam timer: matching his return keeps him from finding a free roam while you are stuck holding a wave.
Track him when he goes missing and shade toward his roam with ult ready: arriving second with Wish turns his pick attempt into a lost play.
Rush Knight's Vow out of early health first when they run all-in burst: the health plus damage redirection keeps your carry alive through the hook-plus-jump window.
Win by staying alive in the backline with your team topped up: as long as you are up with heals and ult ready, their pick comp cannot finish a fight, so never facecheck without minions or backup.
